Question or claim: Which RFP answer is being reused?
Evidence source: Approved answer bank entry, source document link, previous approval record
Risk if unsupported: Outdated or copied answer no longer matches current capability
Safe response boundary: Use as draft only until owner confirms source and date

Question or claim: Does the response describe customer data, retention, residency, subprocessors or training use?
Evidence source: Data inventory, DPA template, subprocessor list, retention policy, redaction rule
Expiry or trigger: New data class, new region, new subprocessor or contract exception
Risk if unsupported: Submission implies privacy or cross-border commitments not approved
Safe response boundary: No legal or privacy advice; cite approved policy language only

Question or claim: Does the response mention controls, access, logging, incidents or audit evidence?
Evidence source: Security control summary, access review record, incident path, evidence-room URL
Expiry or trigger: Control change, incident, new integration or questionnaire update
Safe response boundary: Do not claim certification or control effectiveness unless independently verified

Question or claim: Does the response mention model accuracy, autonomy, human review, unsafe outputs or escalation?
Evidence source: AI-use policy, evaluation notes, human-review rule, escalation playbook, limitation statement
Expiry or trigger: Model, prompt, workflow, risk tier or use-case change
Risk if unsupported: Buyer infers autonomous decision-making or guaranteed accuracy/safety
Safe response boundary: AI output is draft support, not an official representation

Question or claim: Does the response commit to timeline, integrations, onboarding, support or rollback?
Evidence source: Delivery plan, dependency list, acceptance gates, support model, rollback procedure
Expiry or trigger: Scope, integration, staffing or customer dependency change
Risk if unsupported: Unscoped delivery promise becomes commercial expectation
Safe response boundary: State dependencies and acceptance gates before any timeline commitment

Question or claim: Does the response mention price, savings, ROI, capacity, usage, cloud/LLM/GPU cost or FinOps controls?
Evidence source: Pricing assumptions, usage model, FinOps trigger, claim boundary worksheet
Expiry or trigger: Pricing, usage, vendor rate, architecture or customer volume change
Risk if unsupported: Unsupported savings, ROI or cost-control claim
Safe response boundary: No revenue, ROI or cost-saving result claim without verified evidence

Question or claim: Does the response mention SOC 2, ISO, GDPR, HIPAA, EU AI Act or other compliance language?
Evidence source: Certificate or scope document if applicable, counsel-approved response, compliance owner note
Expiry or trigger: Audit scope, regulation, product scope or customer jurisdiction change
Risk if unsupported: Unverified compliance claim or advice-like wording
Safe response boundary: Operational evidence only; final legal/compliance wording requires accountable approval

Question or claim: Will this answer leave the company as an external promise?
Evidence source: Approval log, signer, date, version, redline notes
Expiry or trigger: Material change before submission or buyer clarification
Risk if unsupported: Sales, AI or proposal team submits unapproved external representation
Safe response boundary: Escalate claims about security, privacy, compliance, production readiness, accuracy, savings or timelines
